translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Nabz ne Devet mzli kc tqmnc-ngrde lzke ngr Judz.

content.text: Gct rnge, rtangrtix nim.
Murde nim kc tqbatrple nzesatxpx-zpwxkr drtwrnge.
Apux ncblo kx drtwrde brlxkz x mzte tclvr mrkc lzke,
Mz nzsutitx-zlwzkr drtwrnge nzmnctr-krbo bam.
Suti drtwrnge nzxngi-krbo nzulrm Mangr-nzangiongr
Mz nzmc-krnge zmatq x zluli rm.
Nzkrlz-krnge nivz lrm myaszpx-zlwzle nzlu-krnge mz nrlc.
X glqlz-zvzx nim mz nzaodu-zvz-krm ninge.
X sa na-awi-zvzbo bam
Mz nzglalz-krbo mqnge mz nzkrka'-krbo bam.
Drtwrnge sa naesatxpx zpwx nzmnctr-krbo bam.
X sa na-angrlvzx nim mz nabz kxyrlvi.
Mz nrlckxbq kang kqlu aoti zvz drtwrnge nim,
Vz vz nrlc ngrlxtxpx.
X angrlvzx nim mz nzabrtzngr
Murde okatr-zvzq ninge x tu-zvzme mz nibrnge.
Mnc-amqngitrpo bam,
X lolvz-amqngiq ninge mz mqm kx xplr.
A' ayrkrtxong mz drtc'
Krkcng tzrpilr nanibqlr ninge.
Nibqting nidr mz vea,
Murde kuli kzpeto nangqtilr namz ngrdr.
X ninge, king nem, sa na-abrtzlvzx nim,
Murde ngi-batrpe' nzaovxio-krnge.
X krkcng tzabrtrpzlr drtwrdr bam, sa nabilvzlr nim.
Murde sa nangi-batrpzme mz kxnzpokiang nzmnc-lrpi-krdr.
